description: This header file provides serialization utilities for the Graph class in the torch::nativert namespace, including functions for converting JSON to Graph objects, checking if an argument is symbolic, and converting arguments to Constant values. It also includes relevant external headers related to Graph and serialization types.

methods.name: jsonToGraph
methods.description: Converts a JSON representation of a graph into a Graph object.

methods.name: isSymbolic
methods.description: Checks whether a given Argument is symbolic.

methods.name: constantToValue
methods.description: Converts an Argument into a Constant value, optionally loading node metadata.
